title: SNP rs11618521 modifies transcription factor NANOG-mediated expression of KPNA3 and the age at onset of spinocerebellar ataxia type 3
title_zh: SNP rs11618521 修饰转录因子 NANOG 媒介的 KPNA3 表达和运动失协症类型 3 的发病年龄
abstract: Abstract Intranuclear localization of the affected protein ataxin-3 is critical for the pathogenesis of spinocerebellar ataxia type 3 (SCA3). The nuclear–cytoplasmic transporter karyopherin alpha 3 (KPNA3) has been demonstrated to play an essential role in the pathophysiology of this disorder. In this study, we characterized the single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) rs11618521, located in the KPNA3 promoter, as a genetic modifier of the age at onset in SCA3 and a regulator of the KPNA3 promoter activity. Moreover, we identified the transcription factor Nanog homeobox (NANOG) as a key regulator exerting allele-specific modulatory effects on the KPNA3 promoter activity, thereby modulating expression and contributing to SCA3-associated pathogenic mechanisms. Pharmacological inhibition of NANOG reduced KPNA3 levels and ameliorated aggregate formation. In conclusion, we identified variant rs11618521 as a regulator of KPNA3 promoter activity and as a genetic modifier of SCA3. Moreover, we provide mechanistic insights that may guide future-targeted therapeutic strategies.
abstract_zh: 摘要 脑内受影响蛋白 ataxin-3 的核内定位对运动失协症类型 3 (SCA3) 的病理机制至关重要。核质运输蛋白 karyopherin alpha 3 (KPNA3) 已被证明在该疾病的病理生理过程中起关键作用。在本研究中，我们表征了位于 KPNA3 启动子区域的单核苷酸多态性 (SNP) rs11618521，该多态性作为 SCA3 发病年龄的遗传修饰因子以及 KPNA3 启动子活性的调节因子。此外，我们确定了转录因子 NANOG 为关键调节因子，其产生等位基因特异性调节作用，影响 KPNA3 启动子活性，进而调节表达并参与 SCA3 相关的病理机制。NANOG 的药理抑制降低了 KPNA3 水平并减少了聚集体的形成。总之，我们确定变异 rs11618521 为 KPNA3 启动子活性的调节因子，也是 SCA3 的遗传修饰因子。此外，我们提供了可能指导未来靶向治疗策略的机制见解。
